title: The Three Lighthouse Keepers Who Vanished in 1900
asof: History from National Records of Scotland · full video on the channel

shots.s: In December 1900, a lighthouse in Scotland went dark.
The Flannan Isles, far out in the Atlantic.
A passing steamer noticed the light was out.
On December twenty-sixth, a relief keeper named Joseph Moore landed.
Lamps cleaned and ready. The kitchen tidy.
Two sets of outdoor gear were missing.
The inquiry found storm damage at the landing.
It concluded a huge wave probably swept them away.
